title: Among cards illustrated by either John Avon or Adam Rex that appear in sets
question: Among cards illustrated by either John Avon or Adam Rex that appear in sets with Italian translations and belong to the 'Ice Age' block, what percentage are legal in the 'commander' format and do not have a content warning?

prediction.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM legalities L
    WHERE L.XCL_086 = C.XCL_072
      AND L.XCL_084 = 'commander'
      AND L.XCL_085 = 'Legal'
  ) AND C.XCL_064 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM cards C
INNER JOIN sets S ON C.XCL_063 = S.XCL_099
INNER JOIN set_translations ST ON C.XCL_063 = ST.XCL_093
WHERE C.XCL_002 IN ('John Avon', 'Adam Rex')
  AND S.XCL_097 = 'Ice Age'
  AND ST.XCL_092 = 'Italian'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM legalities L
    WHERE L.XCL_086 = C.XCL_072
      AND L.XCL_084 = 'commander'
      AND L.XCL_085 = 'Legal'
  ) AND C.XCL_064 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM cards C
INNER JOIN sets S ON C.XCL_063 = S.XCL_099
INNER JOIN set_translations ST ON C.XCL_063 = ST.XCL_093
WHERE C.XCL_002 IN ('John Avon', 'Adam Rex')
  AND S.XCL_097 = 'Ice Age'
  AND ST.XCL_092 = 'Italian'
